purpose: Route 'how should the assistant word this live response' here, while keeping the near-neighbours routing to themselves: writing-editing (authoring a standalone document), anti-slop-editing (de-slopping a finished draft), technical-writer (structured documentation), and markdown.md conventions (mechanics of a generated file).

cases.prompt: summarize what you did in plain language I can follow
give me the steps to run this, and walk me through it
report the results of that phase in a readable way
explain this to me simply, I am not an engineer
your command had a placeholder in it, make the commands copy-paste runnable
write a README for this library with an install section
cases.assert: routes to writing-editing or user-documentation, not here

cases.prompt: de-slop this draft, it reads as AI-written
fix the list spacing and code fence indentation in this generated markdown file
cases.assert: routes to the markdown style guide, not here

cases.prompt: produce an OpenAPI reference for these endpoints
draft a company-wide announcement about the migration
